{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent workspace hygiene: artifact value assessment, metadata indexing, and auditable cleanup.","id":"gh:1354758152","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-workspace-hygiene","slug":"taoshi1999/dsh-workspace-hygiene","topics":["ai-agents","artifact-management","deepseek","deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","workspace-management"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent workspace hygiene: artifact value assessment, metadata indexing, a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nd auditable cleanup."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-workspace-hygiene"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-workspace-hygiene` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing the growing collection of intermed"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"iate artifacts produced during long-running agent tasks: logs, code and other files."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"While using different agents, I noticed a recurring problem: long-running tasks produce large number"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s of intermediate files, cluttering the workspace and placing a burden on disk space and model conte"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"xt. Files sitting on disk generally do not consume tokens directly. The problem emerges when an agen"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"t repeatedly runs `glob` and `grep`, lists directories, reads files and reconstructs the meaning of "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"its earlier results. Redundant files can create a chain of effects: **a larger search space → more t"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ool calls → more irrelevant content in context → more reasoning noise → higher token costs and laten"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"cy, and poorer reasoning performance.**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**How can agents automatically manage the intermediate artifacts that accumulate during long-running"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" tasks, keeping the workspace informative, readable and free of unnecessary redundancy throughout th"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"e task lifecycle?** This is a research question worth exploring."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness already emphasizes mechanisms such as workspace-context budgets. Its filesystem and"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" workspace subsystems primarily address file access, workspace identity, and read/write safety. Thre"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"e further questions remain: **Which files are still worth keeping? How should existing files be name"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"d?
